Oliver Hannaoui



Hello. I am a second-year Statistics PhD student at Carnegie Mellon University. I am also a member of Delphi, where I am working on leveraging time-series foundation models for infectious disease forecasting.
Previously, I completed an M1 in Applied Mathematics and Statistics at the Polytechnic Institute of Paris. Prior to that, I spent two formative years at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York as a Senior Research Analyst in the Financial Intermediation group. 
I can be contacted via e-mail or LinkedIn .
